title: Multiperiod bond portfolio optimization with transaction costs using a Markov Decision process
abstract: arXiv:2609.38765v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bank treasury portfolios must balance yield, liquidity, and interest-rate risk across bonds of different maturities. Static allocation rules are ill-suited to this task: portfolios concentrated in long-duration securities with no dynamic adjust- ment mechanism can accumulate large mark-to-market losses and liquidity stress under rising interest rates, as illustrated by the failure of Silicon Valley Bank in 2023. We develop a tractable simulation-based framework for multi-period bond port- folio optimization under interest-rate risk and proportional transaction costs. Yield-curve dynamics are modeled using the Dynamic Nelson-Siegel parameter- ization with Vector Autoregressive factor dynamics, from which we construct a time-inhomogeneous discrete-state Markov chain approximating the joint yield process across bond maturities. translated_title: 基于马尔可夫决策过程的考虑交易成本的多期债券投资组合优化
translated_abstract: 银行司库投资组合需要在不同期限的债券之间平衡收益率、流动性和利率风险。静态配置规则并不适合这一任务：集中于长久期证券且缺乏动态调整机制的投资组合，在利率上升时可能积累大量市值损失和流动性压力，2023年硅谷银行的倒闭就说明了这一点。我们开发了一个易于处理的、基于模拟的框架，用于在利率风险和比例交易成本下进行多期债券投资组合优化。收益率曲线动态采用动态Nelson-Siegel参数化方法并结合向量自回归因子动态进行建模，据此我们构建了一个时间非齐次的离散状态马尔可夫链，用以近似各债券期限的联合收益率过程。该马尔可夫链构成一个有限期马尔可夫决策过程的状态空间，其中投资者在此框架下最大化期望……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种将动态Nelson-Siegel收益率曲线模型与马尔可夫决策过程相结合的基于模拟的优化框架，用于在利率风险和交易成本约束下动态优化多期债券投资组合，以规避硅谷银行倒闭所暴露的静态配置风险。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a tractable simulation-based framework that combines Dynamic Nelson-Siegel yield curve modeling with a finite-horizon Markov Decision Process to dynamically optimize multiperiod bond portfolios under interest-rate risk and transaction costs, addressing the risks of static allocation highlighted by the Silicon Valley Bank failure.
